memories.author: D03
memories.text:
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: New patient with plaque psoriasis on elbows and knees, seeking treatment.
EXAMINATION: BP 122/78 mmHg, weight 68 kg, height 1.62 m, BMI 25.9 (obese). Skin shows well-demarcated erythematous plaques with silvery scale, PASI 6.
IMPRESSION: Chronic plaque psoriasis, obese. Initiate topical therapy and low-dose methotrexate. Advise weight reduction.
ARRANGEMENTS: Start clobetasol 0.05% cream BD to plaques, calcipotriol ointment OD to thighs, methotrexate 7.5 mg PO weekly with folic acid 5 mg OD. LFT, CBC, creatinine today. Return if new joint pain, fever >38.5°C, worsening skin, or mouth ulcers.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
clobetasol 0.05% cream, apply BD to affected areas
calcipotriol ointment, apply OD to thighs
methotrexate 7.5 mg, take once weekly on Monday
folic acid 5 mg, take daily

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Psoriasis improved, mild itching.
EXAMINATION: BP 118/76 mmHg, weight 66 kg, BMI 25.1 (obese). Plaques thinner, scale reduced, PASI 3.
IMPRESSION: Partial response to current regimen. Continue topicals, maintain methotrexate. Reinforce diet and activity for weight.
ARRANGEMENTS: Continue clobetasol BD, calcipotriol OD, methotrexate 7.5 mg weekly, folic acid 5 mg daily. LFT, CBC, creatinine today. Return if severe flare, joint swelling, fever >38.5°C, or mucosal ulcers.

memories.author: lab
memories.text: LFT: ALT 24 U/L, AST 22 U/L, ALP 80 U/L, GGT 32 U/L. CBC: Hb 13.0 g/dL, WBC 6.5 x10^9/L, Plt 205 x10^9/L. Creatinine 0.80 mg/dL.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Routine follow‑up, request flu vaccine.
EXAMINATION: BP 120/78 mmHg, weight 65 kg, BMI 24.7 (overweight). Skin clear, minimal residual plaques, PASI 1.
IMPRESSION: Psoriasis well controlled. Patient overweight, advise continued lifestyle. Offer influenza vaccine due to chronic illness.
ARRANGEMENTS: Continue topical clobetasol BD, calcipotriol OD, methotrexate 7.5 mg weekly, folic acid 5 mg daily. Give inactivated influenza vaccine today (08‑Oct‑2025). LFT, CBC, creatinine today. Return if high fever, worsening rash, joint pain, or breathing difficulty.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Mild flare after winter, increased scaling on scalp.
EXAMINATION: BP 124/80 mmHg, weight 66 kg, BMI 25.2 (obese). Scalp erythema with scale, elbows mild plaque, PASI 4.
IMPRESSION: Winter exacerbation of psoriasis. Increase methotrexate to 10 mg weekly, continue topicals. Monitor LFT.
ARRANGEMENTS: Increase methotrexate to 10 mg PO weekly (take on Monday), keep folic acid 5 mg daily. Continue clobetasol BD, calcipotriol OD. LFT, CBC, creatinine today. Return if severe skin pain, fever >38.5°C, jaundice, or unexplained bruising.

calcipotriol ointment OD
methotrexate 10 mg weekly
folic acid 5 mg daily

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Routine review, labs show mild ALT rise.
EXAMINATION: BP 122/78 mmHg, weight 65 kg, BMI 24.6 (overweight). Skin plaques mild, scalp clear, PASI 2.
IMPRESSION: Psoriasis controlled; ALT 48 U/L (slightly elevated) likely methotrexate‑related. Reduce methotrexate to 7.5 mg weekly, continue folic acid, advise alcohol avoidance.
ARRANGEMENTS: Reduce methotrexate to 7.5 mg PO weekly, keep folic acid 5 mg daily. Continue topical clobetasol BD, calcipotriol OD. Repeat LFT, CBC, creatinine in 6 weeks. Return if jaundice, abdominal pain, fever >38.5°C, or severe skin flare.
